items.briefing:
Cyber threats are escalating globally, with direct implications for Australian organisations. Ransomware attacks surged in July, and while victim numbers have plateaued, the number of active criminal groups has hit a record high — meaning more threat actors are targeting businesses. AI-driven cybercrime is also scaling rapidly, making attacks faster and harder to detect. Separately, a critical vulnerability in VMware vCenter is being actively exploited worldwide; any Australian organisation running VMware infrastructure should ensure patches are applied immediately.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT team today whether your VMware systems are fully patched and up to date.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransoms, revealing critical vulnerability in Australian security posture.
